North-Facing Home Steps from the De Zalze Clubhouse

Web Ref. RLS1008011
The property is located on the De Zalze Golf Estate, near the De Zalze Clubhouse. The house's layout is open, with a skylit stair bringing natural light into the entrance and a north-facing aspect that keeps it light all day.

The spacious outdoor space includes a stunning swimming pool, mountain views, and a covered patio with an integrated braai. The laundry and television rooms open into a yard behind the home with trees and shrubs.

The open-plan kitchen includes a dining room with patio access, breakfast bar seats and an island. A separate laundry room and scullery are located just off the kitchen. The TV lounge has a separate room with a wood-burning fireplace.

The master bedroom upstairs features a vaulted ceiling, exposed steel trusses, and views of the mountains and vineyards. It has a walk-in dressing room and an adjacent bathroom with a freestanding bathtub, a double vanity and a walk-in shower with stone tiles. A study with two built-in desks is located adjacent to the main bedroom. Two extra bedrooms share a family bathroom. A family room is a little pyjama lounge on the landing, with a television and built-in bookcases.

Load shedding or municipal water outages have no effect on the off-grid residence, which has a complete water system and an inverter that powers the entire house.

The De Zalze Estate includes walking and cycling paths, tennis and padel courts, as well as a golf clubhouse.

Offer Rules
You will be notified of other offers via email.

All sales are non-suspensive and sold as is "voetstoots". Properties on sale with a "Offers From" price will be sold subject to confirmation of the seller. The successful buyer cannot occupy the property prior to registration without special arrangement from the seller.
